slug: 2026-03-26 Starlink blocked from operating in Namibia

facts.fact: CRAN denied Starlink's application for a Class Comprehensive Telecommunications Service Licence and a Spectrum Licence for fixed satellite services, having met three of six criteria (failed ownership and control, public security, compliance history); article of 2026-03-26 says confirmed 'this week'.
CRAN issued a cease-and-desist order to Starlink for operating without a licence and ordered confiscation of all Starlink terminal equipment in the country.
